facts: The walls are cyclopean concrete. The first-floor galleries are reconstructed in teak following original arrangements. The work preserves the rotunda and the site’s open galleries.
The 1905 former governor’s residence was restored and reopened as the Palais de Lomé art and culture centre in November 2019.

record: Sonia Lawson, founding director of the Palais de Lomé, restoration project account
facts: Teak and iroko were chosen for first-floor galleries and carpentry. Wooden attic louvers, terraces and the west tower were restored and made accessible.
